title: New Worlds Geopol
description: This is the modpack for the New Worlds GeoPol Server
body:
The modpack for New Worlds GeoPol, featuring tech, magic, and  a whole lot of chaos!

NWGP was made out of unsettlement in the curent geopol sphere, and strive to make something better, taking parts from the bigger, long running players, semi-anarchy and mods.
